scope: Recover one exact historical canonical documentation plan while preserving all normal source-bound engineering verification.
riskAnalysis: Verification-policy source requires STRICT. No history rewrite, runtime gate bypass or general recovery exception; the actual historical commit is independently pinned and classified.

threatModel.assets: Historical source identities, required engineering plans and trustworthy CI admission.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Actual immutable Git trees to one supplemental plan read from the requested verification head.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged historical identity, stale digest, executable or symlink substitution, risk downgrade, duplicate plans or unrelated runtime escape.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact full commit/digest/canonical path, regular parent/current/supplement files, fixed plan path, exact plan identity/routine risk, unchanged ordinary validator.

rollback: Reverting this policy repair restores the historical CI failure; do not rewrite history or skip the gate. Preserve the original failure and correct only the exact documented plan under reviewed policy.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Malformed or incorrect supplement fails ordinary plan parsing and validation; no external response exists.
negativePaths.stale-state: Different commit, blob digest, path or historicalCommit cannot invoke recovery.
negativePaths.concurrency: Immutable Git-tree reads use the requested head; mutable worktree contents cannot replace the supplement.
negativePaths.cancellation: Read-only verification can stop safely without provider calls, grants or application state writes.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No worker is created; interrupted preflight returns no verification receipt.
negativePaths.api-outage: No network provider is involved. Missing Git objects or unavailable files fail closed.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Routine-only recovery is confined to one exact historical documentation delta; all runtime/security commits retain normal requirements.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No paid inference, browser infrastructure, budget change, financial action or recurring work.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Missing or duplicate plans still block; no partial scan can issue execution or publication authority.

defects.rootCause: Canonical-only handoff7934a97 was published without its required engineering plan.
defects.detectionGap: Local verification began after that checkpoint; PR CI correctly walked history from main and found it.
defects.regression: Independent actual-Git tests verify exact recovery, substitution/mode denial and unchanged ordinary validation. Full PR-base verification is now required for this repair.
defects.historicalPrevention: Source-bind documentation checkpoint plans before publishing and validate the full PR base rather than assuming a later local base covers earlier commits.

proactiveReview.architecture: Small extension to existing preflight only; no new journal, authority system or approval workflow.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Immutable historical Git objects, fixed canonical document and head-tree supplemental plan.
proactiveReview.threats: General missing-plan fallback or forged scope could weaken CI; exact immutable pins prohibit both.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Absent/malformed supplement, wrong modes and any mismatched binding remain hard failures.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Independent QA tests altered commits/blobs/paths/modes/plans and confirms unrelated critical missing plans still fail.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate Work Auditor approved actual narrow implementation; independent QA6/6 passed.
proactiveReview.recovery: Preserve historical commits and original failure; correct evidence through this single reviewed supplement, never force-push or skip checks.
proactiveReview.readiness: Requires STRICT against full main comparison, remote CI/CodeQL/Redis and exact Preview verification; this record itself grants no execution authority.
